text:
Sounds like a good place to stop, especially at 2 AM. You covered a lot tonight.

One quick fix before you try these on piano: in version 1, I mislabeled a chord. **C/E** (C major, first inversion) is **E – G – C**, not C – E – A. (C – E – A is actually Am in first inversion, which also works there.)

Get some rest. The motifs will be waiting when you're back at the keys.
